title: Immersion Cooling of EV Batteries
description: Conducted CFD simulations to compare dielectric fluid–based immersion cooling with conventional cold plate cooling in EV battery modules, evaluating thermal performance and potential efficiency gains.
detailedDescription: In-depth technical coverage of battery chemistry analysis, thermal management systems, safety protocols, charging infrastructure, and system integration with vehicle architecture.
challenges: Thermal runaway prevention and solution implemented
Space constraints and innovative packaging approach
